name: finite_scan
requested_by: investigators (py-tgb 2.3.0 ranks NaN positives as rank 1 and drops NaN negatives; no protocol change)
method: every .npy / .npz / .f32 / .pt file under the scope roots; floating-point arrays counted for NaN, +inf and -inf (npz members memory-mapped; float16 upcast; .pt tensors and mu/sd); integer and bool arrays not counted; scanner unit-tested on planted NaN/+inf/-inf in npy, f32, stored and compressed npz

scope.main_table_polecat: tracks/pilot_polecat (LogCL / RE-GCN bases and pipelines), tracks/pc_tirgn (TiRGN pipeline), hardening/tirgn_polecat (TiRGN checkpoint + top-200 dump), hardening/presub_hcpat, presub_hcpat2 (HRCOV_PAT), hardening/rb_polecat
scope.main_table_smallpedia: tracks/pilot_smallpedia (all smallpedia bases: full-row float32 dumps, features, fits), hardening/rb_smallpedia
scope.main_table_controls_recb_blends: hardening/work (RecB tables, valid/test blend and pool outputs)
scope.v7_items: hardening/v7 (A2 scans, B/C pools, fits, lookups, official outputs, B4)
scope.official_outputs_from_serverB / v7_local: local copies of the official per-query outputs used in the manuscript (incl. the serverB-computed polecat TiRGN / LogCL controls, HRCOV_PAT and G1 files)

neginf_check.description: every -inf lies in a candidate log-prob table (*_logp.npy: feature/pool/lookup tables) and was checked against the paired candidate array: -inf only where cand < 0 (padded slot), i.e. an intentional mask; none at a real candidate

reranker_scores_recomputed.description: re-ranker scores are not stored (only promoted lists and ranks); for the default-base main-table rows they were recomputed from the saved models on CPU (valid + test, every candidate slot of the arm window), with the calibrated fused score alpha*logp + beta*f

not_covered: live base replays inside the official scoring pass for TiRGN polecat (test rows re-computed from the checkpoint rather than stored); the checkpoint and stored top-200 / reach dumps are scanned. CognTKE official rows are read from the g8_dump.py sparse store (hd_blend.py --source cogn), which is scanned (0 NaN / 0 inf)
two object-array members ('o3') in exploratory augmentation caches (tracks/pilot_polecat/work/augarms_{logcl,regcn}/S3_cache.npz), not used by any manuscript row
re-ranker scores of non-default bases and of the v7 B/C arms were not recomputed (their inputs - features, base log-probs - and outputs are scanned)

g8.verdict: PASS: no NaN or +inf anywhere; no -inf in the CognTKE dumps; the only -inf values are padded candidate slots in the pc feature log-prob tables; all recomputed HR / HRCOV / HRCOV_PAT scores (valid + test, every slot) and fused scores finite

manuscript_wording: All stored score, probability and feature arrays behind the reported results (about 434 billion values in 2,332 files) were checked: none contains NaN or +inf, and every -inf is an intentional mask at a padded candidate slot; re-ranker scores of the default-base systems, recomputed from the saved models, are all finite.
